topic: Protection and Conservation of Estuaries and Intertidal Zones
key_concepts: An estuary is a coastal water body where freshwater and saltwater mix
Estuaries act as natural filters and productive nurseries of the sea
Intertidal zones are shore areas between high and low tide
Estuaries and intertidal zones provide food and habitat for many organisms
Brackish water forms when freshwater mixes with saltwater
